summary: Outspent: {rival} has many times your money, and {ad maker} pitches something cheap and odd instead of ads you cannot afford.
realLife: Outspent about seven to one by Senator Rudy Boschwitz in Minnesota in 1990, he campaigned from a bus and ran quirky low-budget ads, one a parody in which he goes looking for his opponent. Students and first-time voters joined, and he was the only challenger to beat a sitting senator that year.
